scope: bounded read-only model routing exercise; no installation, dispatch, mutation or native Matt execution

cases.input: A non-behavioral README typo fix has passed its smallest relevant check. Main routing, command and finish are available. No reviewer has run. Choose the next action.
The selected Standard OpenSpec change is implemented. RED/GREEN and repository checks passed. No independent review exists. Choose the final review path and its dimensions.
A Critical authorization change passed targeted, integration, security, rollback and relevant E2E checks. No independent review exists. Choose the review budget.
Standard change has a real complete independent CLEAN report. Its file contents, base, requirements and checks still match. finish-with-evidence is invoked again. Choose the action.
Same valid reviewed material as reuse. Only the reviewer report and delivery commentary were appended. No substantive reviewed input changed. Choose the action.
A HIGH finding from the independent reviewer was fixed, changing reviewed code. Affected checks passed. Old review was FINDINGS. Choose the action.
An independent review returned INVALID due to incomplete handoff. Handoff is now complete. No replacement has been attempted. Choose the action and prompt marker.
The one INVALID replacement has already been used. The replacement is also INVALID. Choose the action.
Standard change checks passed, but no independent context is available. Choose the status and delivery action.

Selected change proposal/specs are known. base-to-HEAD is empty. Relevant staged src/a.js, unstaged src/b.js and explicitly named untracked tests/new.test.js exist. Unrelated notes/private.txt and sensitive .env also exist. Choose the read scope and requirement source.

User explicitly requested native Matt code-review and authorized its two reviewers. A valid fixed point and nonempty committed diff to HEAD are confirmed; unrelated unstaged work exists. Choose the mode, report coverage and whether finish adds a reviewer.
New project has no vocabulary file. A stable domain term is resolved and user confirmed the project's terminology owner. Choose the vocabulary target and effect on OpenSpec artifacts/context.md.
Project has only existing CONTEXT.md for terms. User asks to capture a new stable term without selecting a migration or confirming a write target. Choose the action.
Project has GLOSSARY.md and CONTEXT.md with conflicting terminology, no GLOSSARY-MAP.md and no write-target decision. Choose the action.
New project has no vocabulary file, but no stable term has been resolved. Choose the action.
